details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: Peer impersonation via a certificate subject field
     containing an embedded NUL byte
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-84790.patch: reject certificate subjects
       with embedded NUL bytes in x509_get_subject() and the field
       extraction helpers in src/openvpn/ssl_verify_openssl.c and
       src/openvpn/ssl_verify_mbedtls.c
     - CVE-2026-84790
   * SECURITY UPDATE: Unsanitized control channel messages could inject
     arbitrary data into client logs
     - debian/patches/CVE-2024-5594.patch: split control channel messages
       on NUL bytes and drop any command containing non-printable
       characters in src/openvpn/forward.c, src/openvpn/buffer.c,
       src/openvpn/buffer.h
     - CVE-2024-5594
